suite.name: SCG Connection-Rate Suite
suite.description: Measures fresh-connection rate and completed-path establishment latency. Connector threads open an ingress connection, send a one-frame probe, and wait for the backend close; gateway rows therefore include forwarding and the configured internal TLS handshake rather than only a TCP three-way handshake. The 'connections' field is connector parallelism, not steady-state connection count. UDP/DTLS remains out of scope because the gateway datagram path is connectionless.
suite.author: SESHAT
